title: Surrender a qualified supervisor certificate
summary: Learn how to surrender your qualified supervisor certificate at a Service NSW Centre if you no longer need it.
intro: If you no longer require your qualified supervisor certificate, you can surrender it at a Service NSW Centre. You need to surrender it if you've stopped doing supervision work in NSW – for example, due to retirement or if you're moving to another state.
who_can_apply: You need to surrender your certificate if you have stopped doing supervision work in NSW, for example, due to retirement or moving to another state.

how_to_steps.text: Complete the form and submit it at a service centre.
